title: Art worth arguing about
desc: Pick one work you love and one you do not get. Trade theories before reading the labels.
time: Tue–Fri 10–5; Thu until 8 during classes; Sat 10–4. Closed Sunday.

title: Make a mug with personality
desc: Paint different versions of the same idea. A tiny inside joke can become an actual object.
note: Ask about firing and pickup timing before starting; pieces may not be ready before you leave.

title: Solve a wall together
desc: Bouldering is a puzzle you solve with your whole body. Try easy routes, then cheer each other through one harder move.
note: Ages 10+ welcome; under 14 needs a grown-up. Complete the required waiver; check guardian rules for minors.

title: Climb, then get a snack
desc: The downtown Champaign location makes a satisfying active start before books, games or food.
note: Check first-visit and guardian waiver requirements.

title: Become the puzzle-solving team
desc: Immersive rooms, hidden clues and a shared mission. Let everyone be good at a different part.
time: Reservation required · choose an available slot
note: Check room player minimums: Forest of Fables is 4–8 players, recommended 13+, with a live actor. Pick a room that fits your group.

title: Try an art heist
desc: Abstract Larceny puts an artsy twist on team puzzles. Compare room themes before booking.
time: Fri starts 3–9; Sat 11–11; Sun noon–6:30. Mon–Thu closed.
note: Book ahead; confirm the selected room’s group size and adult accompaniment policy.

title: Roll into the evening
desc: Music, movement and a little friendly chaos. Nobody has to be an expert to have a good night.
note: Published recurring public-session hours checked Oct 13. Laser tag is open during public sessions.

title: Swap wheels for blades
desc: A public ice-skating session is a good change of pace. Pick a session from the arena calendar first.
time: Schedule needed · Oct 14 session not verified
note: Community session access and exact times must be checked; do not assume the earlier chat’s Wednesday time.

title: The ridiculous book hunt
desc: Give everyone a mission: weirdest cover, a book for someone else, or a title that sounds like your life right now.
where: Jane Addams Book Shop · downtown Champaign
note: The upper floors involve stairs; check access needs before visiting.

title: Books + a café pause
desc: Browse The Literary, pick a book, then trade first-page reviews over something to eat or drink.

title: Cats, snacks, board games
desc: Choose a game with room for conversation. Add a cat-lounge visit if everybody wants one.
cost: Paid lounge / café; check game fee
note: Reserve the cat lounge ahead. Under 7 cannot enter; ages 7–12 need an adult and have limited spots.

title: A night under the dome
desc: Trade the phone screen for a planetarium sky. Choose the actual show together from the ticket calendar.
time: Show booking needed · Friday titles/times not confirmed
note: The earlier Friday Prairie Skies / Violent Universe itinerary is not treated as confirmed.

title: A low-stakes game of HORSE
desc: Bring a ball, make up one ridiculous shot each, and keep the competition friendly.
time: Flexible · daylight and posted park rules
note: Outdoor basketball is listed. Check current conditions; park improvements are being planned.

title: Sculpture + prairie photo walk
desc: Find three shapes, colors or scenes worth turning into art. Sketch, photograph, or just wander.

title: A quiet garden hour
desc: Walk slowly, bring a sketchbook, and leave room for a conversation—or no conversation at all.
note: Indoor tours and tea ceremonies require appointments; the garden walk is independent.

title: Make a tiny fall field guide
desc: Pair the Arboretum and Idea Garden with Japan House. Collect photos of leaves, textures and colors, not plants.

title: The sculpture-in-the-woods day
desc: Take a longer walk through gardens and woods. Make your own award for the strangest sculpture.
note: Arrange a round-trip ride. Some routes are uneven; download a trail map.

title: Boardwalk reset
desc: Try Busey Woods for a quieter fall walk. Make a bird-photo challenge and let the walk set the pace.

title: A world-culture wander
desc: Choose an object you would put in a story. Explain your choice to the others.
time: Tue noon–5; Wed–Fri 9–5; Sat 10–4; Sun noon–4
note: Museum asks that children be accompanied by an adult.

title: Underpinnings: look below the surface
desc: Explore fiber, ceramics, prints and mixed media. Which artwork makes you want to try a new material?
time: Through Nov 7. Mon–Wed 10–5; Thu 10–7; Sat noon–3. No Fri/Sun hours listed.
note: Exhibition dates and fall hours verified on Parkland’s announcement.

title: The cider-and-pumpkins stop
desc: Get something from the bakery, choose a pumpkin, and take the kind of fall photos you will laugh about later.
time: Seasonal visit · check hours and activity availability
note: A relaxed fall stop; do not assume every attraction is open on weekdays.

title: Goats + a farm snack
desc: Visit during open farm hours for paths, goats and something to eat. Keep restaurant service hours in mind.
note: Seasonal hours. Farm is cashless; confirm any tour separately.

title: The small-budget book stop
desc: Give everyone a small book budget. See who finds the best surprise.
note: Members’ half-price sale is listed Oct 16–18; membership is $10.

title: Try a shared virtual adventure
desc: Compare VR experiences at JJ’s FunHouse and choose something everyone is comfortable trying.
note: Operator advertises ages 11+. Check game availability and minor participation requirements.

title: Bring-your-own game picnic
desc: Take a card game, snacks and a blanket to a park. A three-person game beats scrolling in parallel.

title: Meet artist Anida Yoeu Ali
desc: Ask a working artist about a creative choice or a medium you want to try.

title: Live jazz, no ticket needed
desc: Hear the Kyle Swan Quartet in Krannert’s lobby. A good first live-music stop for the whole group.
note: Uncorked is a concert series; teens can enjoy the music without buying alcohol.

title: The Space Between the Notes
desc: Try a new musical world with sitar, Zitar and ensemble led by Niladri Kumaar.
note: Book tickets; confirm fees and availability.

title: October Dance
desc: For the athletic + artsy combination: watch how physical skill turns into an idea.
note: Choose one night and book tickets.

title: Performance for Non-Dancers
desc: Turn ordinary gestures into a performance. You do not need a dance background.

title: Make something at Douglass
desc: Explore 3D printing and other creative tools. Bring an idea; ask staff what is possible in one visit.
note: Walk-ins welcome; reserve specific equipment if needed. Printing may take longer than your visit.

title: A film that starts a conversation
desc: If Hafez Wrote a Haiku for Cowboys connects lives across Iran, Japan and the US.
note: Film is 115 minutes with a discussion afterward. This overlaps the makerspace: choose one.

title: Saturday breakfast, outside
desc: Choose a food stop, browse makers, and let everyone nominate one interesting find.
where: Market at the Square · Illinois & Vine
note: Date follows the official May–October Saturday schedule; rain or shine.

title: The Sunday goat celebration
desc: Costumed goats, local makers, music and food. Come hungry and give yourselves room to wander.
note: Goat parades 11 am & 1 pm. Separate 1:30 pm goat hike has limited spots; book it separately.

title: Exoplanets—in Spanish
desc: Beyond the Sun explores other worlds under the planetarium dome. Choose this if a Spanish-language show sounds good.
note: Spanish-language presentation; tickets online or at the door 30 minutes before.
